intro: Kevin says spraying WD-40 on a car battery brings it back to life. It won't, but it does have a real job there. Half the batteries people throw away were fine: crust on the clamps, a loose clamp, short trips or a hidden drain. Here's the safe cleaning, 3 free tests with a $15 meter, home charging, the ground strap, when to really replace it, how to buy one, and 5 myths. Episode 9 of "Miss Doris's Car".
